title: Include reusable catalog in canonical exports
description: Extend canonical export and the legacy --export-tasks alias to write reusable.json beside canonical task UUID snapshots and handoffs.json. Always emit a valid version-1 catalog, including an empty definitions array, and treat reusable.json as a managed export entry for unmanaged-directory checks and stale cleanup. Capture tasks, handoffs, and reusable definitions from one consistent store-locked snapshot so exported task references always resolve. Preserve overlap rejection, deterministic task ordering, atomic file replacement, and idempotent repeat exports. Add Unix/Windows export tests for empty/populated catalogs, live renames, assigned definitions, exact managed-file sets, stale reusable cleanup, injected write/removal failure, and legacy alias parity.

Added assigned-definition/rename, empty/populated, exact managed set, stale replacement, write/removal fault, alias parity, and Unix/Windows coverage. Verified focused suites, go test ./..., fault-injection flat-file tests, Windows-targeted flat-file compilation, and git diff --check.
